responsibility: Defines the module's tests for the sorted-slice multimap search helper, validating that it returns the exact matching subslice for present keys and an empty slice for absent keys across single and repeated-key cases.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the broader container test files, this `tests.rs` is focused on one slice-search helper, checking that binary search returns the exact contiguous subslice for duplicate keys and an empty slice for absent keys.
